sar.narrative: On 2016-11-21, customer C07297 reported or was alerted to activity on card C07297-K1. The reviewed transaction 3476682 was a online purchase of $482.12. The transaction occurred at 2016-11-21 20:30:00 under product code C. The bank's detection model assigned a risk score of 0.25, which prompted investigation. Graph review identified the following pattern: card not present new device. The customer denied authorization or evidence established strong suspicion, and the bank assessed fraud probability at 0.86. The total identified suspicious exposure is $1906.07. The bank created an internal case, preserved supporting transaction and graph evidence, and will seek the required approval for containment and filing.
